content_blocks.label: clause_1._Defined_Terms
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether oral, written, or electronic.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Restrictions
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall not use, disclose, or copy any Confidential Information without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_Duration
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect indefinitely until terminated in writing by either party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of April 2024.
